name: Dark Pacts
text: Each time this unit is selected to shoot or to fight, you may make a Dark Pact for it. It takes a Leadership test; on a failure it suffers D3 mortal wounds. Whether it passed or failed, choose [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1]: until the end of the phase every weapon in the unit has that ability. Fire Overwatch does not offer a Pact.

name: Sacrificial Dagger
text: Once per phase, when this model is selected to shoot or fight, you may have its unit suffer 1 mortal wound. If you do, until the end of the phase this model's Psychic attacks gain +1 to hit and +1 to wound.

name: Veterans of the Long War
text: Melee attacks made by models in this unit re-roll a wound roll of 1. If the target is within range of an objective marker, they may re-roll any failed wound roll instead.
